question: Which of the following Brazilian cities hosted the 17th BRICS Summit on 6–7 July 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rio de Janeiro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Brazil** officially assumed the **Presidency** of the **BRICS** group for the year **2025**, succeeding **Russia**, which held the chairmanship in **2024**.
 
• The **17th BRICS Summit** is scheduled to be hosted in the city of **Rio de Janeiro** on **6–7 July 2025**.
 
• The summit in **Rio de Janeiro** represents the first major gathering of the expanded **BRICS+** bloc under **Brazilian** leadership, following the historic expansion that included **Egypt**, **Ethiopia**, **Iran**, and the **United Arab Emirates (UAE)**.
 
• The **Brazilian Chairmanship** has prioritized themes such as **global governance reform**, **sustainable development**, and **energy transition** as part of the **2025** agenda.
 
• The choice of **Rio de Janeiro**, a major cultural and economic hub, aligns with **Brazil's** strategy to showcase its international standing and its role in **South-South cooperation**. ***Hence, the correct answer is Rio de Janeiro.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Evolution of BRICS**:
 
 
• The acronym **BRIC** was first coined in **2001** by **Jim O'Neill** of **Goldman Sachs** to identify the fast-growing economies of **Brazil**, **Russia**, **India**, and **China**.
 
• The first formal summit took place in **Yekaterinburg**, **Russia**, in **June 2009**. **South Africa** was invited to join the group in **December 2010**, turning the acronym into **BRICS**.
 
 
 
• **Brasilia**:
 
 
• As the federal capital of **Brazil**, **Brasilia** has hosted several high-level diplomatic events, including the **11th BRICS Summit** in **November 2019**.
 
• It remains the center for administrative and legislative decisions but was not the primary host city for the **July 2025** summit.
 
 
 
• **Sao Paulo**:
 
 
• Known as the financial heart of **Brazil** and the most populous city in the **Southern Hemisphere**, **Sao Paulo** frequently hosts **BRICS Business Forums** and financial track meetings.
 
• It plays a vital role in **trade relations** and **foreign direct investment** within the bloc.
 
 
 
• **Manaus**:
 
 
• Located in the **Amazon** region, **Manaus** often serves as a venue for **BRICS** discussions related to **environmental policy**, **biodiversity**, and the **bio-economy**.
 
• It is a key location for **Brazil's** environmental diplomacy but does not serve as the main **2025** summit host.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **New Development Bank (NDB)**: Established during the **6th BRICS Summit** in **Fortaleza**, **Brazil** (**2014**), the **NDB** is headquartered in **Shanghai**, **China**. It provides funding for infrastructure and sustainable projects in **emerging markets**.
 
• **Contingent Reserve Arrangement (CRA)**: A framework established by **BRICS** nations to provide **liquidity support** and protection against global financial pressures, strengthening the **financial safety net** of member states.
 
• **Rotation Policy**: The **Chairmanship** of **BRICS** rotates annually among members according to the acronym. Following **Brazil** in **2025**, the presidency will move to **Russia** (based on the updated rotation including new members).
 
• **BRICS+ Expansion**: The **15th Summit** in **Johannesburg** (**2023**) led to the invitation of new members, significantly increasing the bloc's share of the **global GDP** and **world population**.
